BatchIn.title: BatchIn
BatchIn.description: Pasted site URLs (newline- or comma-separated). Feed discovery is the system's job.

ConnectorStatus.title: ConnectorStatus
ConnectorStatus.description: Reported state of a single connector.

ConnectorStatusResponse.title: ConnectorStatusResponse
ConnectorStatusResponse.description: Envelope for the connector status list.

CountryCoverageOut.title: CountryCoverageOut
CountryCoverageOut.description: Outlet count for one source country (where the outlet is based).

CoverageAngleOut.title: CoverageAngleOut
CoverageAngleOut.description:
One angle (framing sub-cluster) of an event's coverage — the Google-News
"Full Coverage" grouping. Outlets in an angle framed the story similarly
(grouped by document-embedding similarity). ``label`` is the angle's
representative headline (translated when available); attribution-only, no body.

CoverageItemOut.title: CoverageItemOut
CoverageItemOut.description: One outlet's coverage of an event-backed story (attribution, sorted by time).

FullCoverageOut.title: FullCoverageOut
FullCoverageOut.description:
Full-coverage breakdown for an event-backed story (P8): coverage grouped
into angles plus by-country and entity-targeted stance facets. Every outlet
carries attribution (name + original url); no body text is included.

RightsPatchIn.title: RightsPatchIn
RightsPatchIn.description: Manual rights change. Upgrading to ``full_ok`` requires a ``rights_note``.

StanceSummaryOut.title: StanceSummaryOut
StanceSummaryOut.description:
Entity-targeted stance breakdown across the event's coverage. Counts are of
documents; ``unassessed`` = documents with no stance row (honest — never
inferred). ``assessed`` is False when the whole event has no stance data.

StoryOut.title: StoryOut
StoryOut.description:
The single reader story payload. Built ONLY by ``site.serializers.to_story_out``.

``body_en`` is present only for ``full_ok`` sources; ``extract_en`` is capped at
the source's content-rights length. ``source_name`` and ``url`` (the original
article) are always populated (the attribution gate).
